en: An old Russian imperial-era postal card with printed Russian text at the top reading 'ПОЧТОВАЯ КАРТОЧКА' (Postcard) and a double‑headed imperial eagle emblem on the upper left. The card is filled in with handwritten Cyrillic address lines. There are two overlapping round postal stamps, one in black and one in purple, bearing the imperial eagle and Russian text around the edges. The bottom line of print states that only the address should be written on this side, and the printer's line at the lower right indicates it was printed in Kiev.
